description: The line plot illustrates the performance of two methods — “Ours” and “ReFICR” — across five distinct points on the x-axis, likely representing experimental conditions or model iterations, with values ranging from 1 to 5. The left y-axis, labeled “Recall@50”, spans from 0.30 to 0.60 and measures the recall metric for both methods; the right y-axis, labeled “NDCG@50”, ranges from 0.15 to 0.22 and measures the normalized discounted cumulative gain. The green solid line with circular markers represents “Recall@50 (Ours)”, which starts at approximately 0.35 at x=1 and rises steadily to about 0.49 at x=5. The green dotted line, “Recall@50 (ReFICR)”, remains nearly flat around 0.48 across all x-values. The blue solid line with square markers, “NDCG@50 (Ours)”, begins at approximately 0.16 at x=1 and increases to about 0.185 at x=5. In contrast, the blue dotted line, “NDCG@50 (ReFICR)”, stays constant near 0.15 across the entire x-axis. The plot includes a legend in the upper left and a gray placeholder box at the top center, suggesting a title or label may be missing. Gridlines are present to aid in reading values.
